tool_args.rationale: The authorized mechanism specifies a four-parameter cooperative Hill response with sink inhibition and linear bleed. Five observations with a broad gradient span support numerical fitting; fresh confirmation will test the resulting prediction against the requested tolerance.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five pilot rows span s_grad from 0.25 to 2.25, so the specified narrow-gradient trigger does not apply.
These alternatives do not account for the observed sink-gradient dependence as directly as the verified Hill-inhibition mechanism.
The verified readout is a present snapshot, so additional trajectory measurements are not needed for identification.
